title: Burns on light setting
text: Burns on light setting. There's no winning with this thing.  You have to stand at the toaster, watching.  The second you stop watching... it burns. You can't get an exact amount of time or heat.  You just turn the knob and hope for the best.  I got this thing at Walmart and thankfully I can return it.  I ordered a more expensive one on Amazon that looked like it solved the issues this one is having.

product_metadata.title: Mainstays 4-Slice Toaster Oven, Black, Includes 1 baking rack and 1 baking pan
description: The Mainstays Toaster Oven allows you to easily toast up to 4 slices at once. Perfect for preparing toast, sandwiches, pizza and much more. The Mainstays Toaster Oven can accommodate up to 4 slices of bread or bagel halves or a 9-inch pizza. The turn dial allows you to easily adjust the temperature mode and time settings. Includes dishwasher-safe rack and pan for easy clean up without the fuss. Makes mealtime swift and smooth, especially in busy households. The sleek black finish will coordinate beautifully with existing kitchen decor and color palettes. Mainstays Toaster Oven is sure to become a staple in your home cooking and baking ventures - add it to your kitchen today!
